title: State transition — structural placeholder
description: Recoverable account of an exact change in supported State, without presuming lawful motion or succession at another layer.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

locality.description: Exact Locality holding the change account.

predecessor_state.description: Recoverable supported State before the transition.

resulting_state.description: Supported resulting posture; an invalid act may still have actual consequences.

target.description: Exact target and layer of change, without effects inferred at other layers.

classification.description: Supported kind of change under Article 17, or preserved unresolved classification.

basis.description: Attributable ground of the change and any claimed constitutional effect; missing or disputed basis remains visible.

effective_boundary.description: Exact occurrence or temporal boundary of the change.

transition_evidence.description: Support for the occurrence and delta, with a bounded proof ceiling.

delta.description: What changed, remained, ended, or remains unresolved.

discontinuity.description: Interruption, conflict, or lost support retained rather than concealed.

lineage.description: Exact predecessor and resulting relations; any succession claim needs its own supported basis.

correction.description: Recoverable correction account where the transition corrects an earlier error.
